German Left Party Wins Berlin Election Amid Eastern AfD Gains

Germany's Left party (Die Linke) has won the Berlin election, a victory that offers a contrast to the strategy of similar parties in other countries. Amid this win, the AfD has strengthened its hold in eastern Germany. Immigrant communities in Berlin have expressed hope following the Left party's victory.
